title: tephrosia genistoides
intro: Tephrosia genistoides, commonly known as the 'yellow pea', is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is known for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia genistoides are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
